title: I can't show you how pink this pink is.
summary: Tom Scott explains why a vivid pink pigment by artist Stuart Semple cannot be fully shown on a screen, and touches on the dispute over exclusive rights to the blackest black pigment. It is a short explainer on color gamuts and pigment politics.
why: Cited as an example of colors too vibrant for monitors and pigments outside the sRGB gamut.

quote.text: these colors are so vibrant, they cannot be accurately displayed on monitors
